dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular closed and semi-closed 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored rings with jagged, meandering edge geometry. Sharp high-contrast transitions from the dark exterior to light perimeters, enclosing dark internal patches.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density. Light markings primarily consist of narrow filament-like lines; high-intensity pixel concentrations are limited to small nodal points at line intersections rather than solid clusters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent annular structures (upper right, mid-right, and central-left) form an obtuse triangle with the longest axis oriented roughly parallel to the dorsal-lateral curvature.
